description: This file is the main implementation of the 'git' command-line interface, handling command parsing, execution, and internal command dispatching.

methods.name: list_cmds
methods.description: Lists available commands based on a specification string, such as 'builtins', 'main', 'others', 'nohelpers', 'alias', 'config', 'deprecated', or 'list-<category>'.

methods.name: commit_pager_choice
methods.description: Sets the environment variable for the pager based on the current configuration.

methods.name: setup_auto_pager
methods.description: Configures whether to use a pager for output, based on command and default setting.

methods.name: print_system_path
methods.description: Prints the system path for a given path type (html, man, info).

methods.name: handle_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options and sets environment variables or internal flags accordingly.

methods.name: handle_alias
methods.description: Expands command aliases, handling recursive and loop detection.

methods.name: run_builtin
methods.description: Executes a built-in command, handling setup, environment, and output.

methods.name: execv_dashed_external
methods.description: Executes external 'git-' commands that are not built-in, handling errors.

methods.name: is_deprecated_command
methods.description: Checks if a command is marked as deprecated.

methods.name: run_argv
methods.description: Main loop for executing commands, handling alias expansion, built-in execution, and external command fallback.

methods.name: cmd_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git' command-line interface, parsing arguments, handling special cases, and dispatching commands.
